headline.text: L3 ML4 down *12 hours* on depositor and cooler faults — packaging team sent home, still troubleshooting at 12:11.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 had a 30-minute stop when checkweigher belts were set wrong, then ran caustic and restarted by 09:42. Sollich 4 ran caustic and is back up. Sollich 1 began depositing at 12:31. Time clock in lunch room is out of order with a server fault.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had a sensor fault at shift start, fixed in 27 minutes. FFS completed a changeover to 15.5oz variety and restarted at 11:30, then had a 7-minute stop for checkweigher blow-offs. Both lines running at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 has been down since overnight with depositor 2 faults, cooler filling issues, mold jams, and depositor 1 slider registration problems. Packaging team sent home at 12:11. ML1 started at 06:05 and ran all day with minor temper adjustments. Truffle line restarted after a morning stop. MF Matrix had a suction cup shortage resolved quickly.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 checkweigher infeed belts running slow
resolved.summary: Line stopped because infeed belts to checkweigher were set up wrong and going very slow; recipe still set to Allfill and Matrixes instead of current product.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:05 — "The recipe was still set to Allfill and Matrixes" identified by Caleb York, accumulation passed, line restarted.

resolved.title: ML2 sensor B299 misaligned at shift start
resolved.summary: Sensor preventing line start; maintenance found alignment issue and corrected it.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:55 — "Maintenance adjusted sensor B299" and "Line is running" (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: FFS changeover to 15.5oz variety product
resolved.summary: Planned changeover from 11-piece pouches to 15.5oz variety; line stopped at 07:19 after completing work order.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:30 — "Line has been running since 1130" (Jeffrey Barney) after dialing in the new product.

resolved.title: MF Matrix suction cup shortage
resolved.summary: Only one suction cup remaining, then another broke during shift; no spares in stock.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:32 — "Supervisor brought over 10 suction cups for both upper and bottom" and "This was fixed in 4 min."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 caramel pieces with feet and Cavanna feed issues
needs_attention.summary: Seeing feet on caramels, pieces having hard time going into Cavannas; rails to Cavanna 4 opened up, discharge belt for Cavanna 3 needs trimming.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 12:07 to pass accumulation; maintenance working with operators on adjustments.

needs_attention.title: Time clock in lunch room out of order
needs_attention.summary: Time clock showing "no communication with server" fault, preventing employees from clocking in/out.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 12:44; no follow-up or resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS checkweigher blow-offs for highs and lows
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 12:24 due to too many blow-offs on weight checks after changeover restart.
needs_attention.status: Line back up at 12:32 after 7-minute adjustment; monitoring ongoing.

needs_attention.title: ML2 broken spare vacuum for 60g Feastables
needs_attention.summary: Spare vacuum unit for 60g product found broken during CIL; missing the broken part that might be weldable.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:56; no replacement ordered or repair initiated by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 2 faults and cooler filling issues
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 2 showing faults at 05:41, turned off to bypass and load molds; cooler 2 not filling properly at 06:22; WDS programmer called in remotely multiple times; mold jam on cooler 2 at 10:13; depositor 1 sliders not purging correctly at 12:10.
needs_attention.status: Packaging team sent home at 12:11. Shawn identified depositor 1 slider registration issue at 12:45 (registered as type 7 instead of type 3, causing open position to stop at 70 degrees instead of 109). Pump system being cleaned and reinstalled.
